name: Numen Agent
description: Built-in AI assistant that chats through a connection to OpenRouter, OpenAI or an OpenAI-compatible server

settings.title: Connection
settings.description: The service the agent chats through, with its model and reasoning level.

settings.title: Max Tokens
settings.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate per completion

settings.title: Max Steps
